name: Sargeras
summary: Once the Pantheon’s greatest warrior, Sargeras now leads the Burning Legion against all life. Despair turned him against his kind, and his designs brought the Sundering and later demonic catastrophes.

sections.title: Champion of the Pantheon
sections.body: Sargeras once guarded the Pantheon’s creations across the Great Dark Beyond. The Pantheon of Order had charged their greatest warrior with that duty. There he fought demons born in the Twisting Nether. Unable to imagine pure evil, he trapped countless fiends in a great prison. Yet eons of battle against cosmic horrors slowly wore down his altruistic spirit.

sections.title: Despair and the Burning Crusade
sections.body: Across eons of battle, Sargeras lost faith in the titans’ work. Despair at the evil he faced led him to believe creation was flawed and order could never prevail. He turned from the Pantheon and shattered the demons’ prison. Then he took up the chaotic fel fire he had once fought. Sargeras gathered the freed demons into the Burning Legion, an army bent on scouring life from the cosmos.

sections.title: Obsession with Azeroth
sections.body:
Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara and her Highborne wielded reckless magic that reached across the stars. That magic revealed Azeroth to Sargeras. From the depths of the Well of Eternity, the Dark Titan whispered to Azshara and seduced her into opening a portal for his vanguard.

The invasion ended in the catastrophic Sundering. Yet Sargeras kept plotting to consume Azeroth. He orchestrated the opening of the Dark Portal and guided the demonic corruption of the orcish Horde.

faq.answer: Sargeras is a fallen titan who once served as the Pantheon’s greatest warrior. Despair over cosmic evil turned him against his kind. He forged the Burning Legion to purge life from the universe.

faq.q: Why does Sargeras want to destroy the universe?
aliases: why does sargeras want to destroy everything
faq.answer: Eons of battle with demons and corruption drove Sargeras to despair. He came to believe creation was flawed and order could never prevail. So he chose to burn away all life.

faq.q: What is Sargeras's connection to Queen Azshara?
faq.answer: Ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara’s reckless use of the Well of Eternity drew Sargeras’s attention. She and her Highborne saw him as a god and tried to summon the Dark Titan through the Well. Their attempt brought the War of the Ancients and the Great Sundering.

aliases: where did the burning legion come from
faq.answer: No. Demons arose naturally in the chaotic Twisting Nether. Sargeras fought and imprisoned them for ages, then broke their prison and united them under his command as the Burning Legion.

faq.q: What happened to the other titans?
faq.answer: Mortal scholars do not know what became of the other titans. They left Azeroth long ago after shaping it. Nothing known on Azeroth tells what became of them after Sargeras turned against his kin.

faq.q: How was Sargeras connected to the opening of the Dark Portal?
faq.answer: Long after the Sundering, Sargeras pursued his designs on Azeroth from afar. He arranged the corruption of the orcs of Draenor and used the guardian Medivh to tear open the Dark Portal. Invasion came to mortal shores again.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, Sargeras is the architect of the Great Sundering. His whispers corrupted Queen Azshara and shattered ancient Kalimdor ten thousand years ago.
As a warlock, you draw on fel power and demon servants bound together by the Dark Titan. You wield the ruinous sorceries that formed the Legion.
The tragic history of the orcish clans traces back to Sargeras and his demonic lieutenants. Their blood-curse and madness led to the invasion of Azeroth.
As a mage, you remember Sargeras as a terror. Unchecked arcane ambition drew the Burning Legion’s gaze across the stars.
